title: Evil Trivia Bots
description: Turns the Life Series trivia/santa bots evil
body:
**A resource pack made for the [Life Series](https://modrinth.com/mod/life-series) mod**

This resource pack changes the following mobs to be evil, with plans to add custom sounds in the future:
- Trivia Bot
- Santa Bot
- VHSnail

To use it just put the pack above the Life Series default resourcepack and enjoy a brand new trivia bot.

![Thumbnail](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/zVgMkdRB/images/549b4e802f7e4f5b9590abc475642e2d01de7a70.jpeg)
